  
 **Team Agreement V1**  
---
*2026/09/21 - Milestone 0*
*Team name: UberAte*  
*Group members:* Samuell Bueno (75770727), Kaid Silzer-Krueckl (70614912), Jessie Beggs(98220908), Denton Manders(15627003)

*Team Values.*  
Our team has agreed upon upholding the following values:  
Accountability: We own our work and take responsibility for all our commitments to the project.  
Respect: We listen to each other, value diverse perspectives, and treat all team members fairly.  
Communication: We share information openly and address issues directly and constructively.  
Quality: We aim for professional, well-tested, documented code and decisions.  
Reliability: We follow through on commitments and support each other to succeed.

*Meetings*.  
Weekly Meetings: Mondays or Tuesdays at 4:00pm  
All team members are expected to be present and active in all meetings. If a team member is not able to attend a meeting it is expected that the absence is communicated beforehand. However, we all comprehend that unexpected circumstances are possible and may affect attendance.

*Communication*.  
Most of the group’s communication will be through WhatsApp, as all our members have experience using the platform and its group chat functionality.

*Response Expectations.*  
Team members should respond to messages within 24hrs. If a team member has a planned absence where they will be without wifi/service, let the team know ahead of time.

*Respect & Professional Conduct*.  
We’ll encourage team members to share their ideas and clearly communicate. Dismissing others’ ideas will not be tolerated.

*Accountability*.  
We will implement a strike system. If a member fails to follow the rules and values hereby listed we will consider that infraction a strike. After 3 strikes the group will escalate the matter to the professor or the lab section TA. This system hopes to reinforce the values listed above while also giving room for members to improve and redeem themselves.

*Decision-Making.*  
We’ll try to reach a consensus decision, if we cannot reach a consensus we will use a majority vote. 

*Conflict Resolution.*  
Elaborating on our strike system at strikes 1 and 2 the team member will be confronted by the group in a respectful manner in order to address the issue and openly elaborate on a solution that works best for the team. At strike 3 the conflict must be escalated to the TA or to the professor as it represents a lack of willingness to improve and respect the team.

*Anticipated Challenges.*

* Unequal Contributions  
  * Communicate early if you feel you have too much/too little work and we can re-distribute the work among team members  
* Scheduling Conflicts  
  * If a team member cannot attend a meeting, communicate early so that we can reschedule the meeting to online or a different date/time  
* Disagreements Between Team Members  
  * Strike system\!

*Individual Commitments.*  
We all commit to the following:

* Completing assigned work on time  
  * This means respecting all group deadlines as well as course deadlines.   
* Attending meetings  
  * This means attending all meetings, unless you have another commitment, and in that case you must clearly communicate early so that we can reschedule.  
* Communicating regularly  
  * Updating progress through whatsapp and regular updates to your specific work so everyone stays in the loop.  
* Contributing fairly  
  * We all hope to contribute equally to the project and communicate if any unequal work is being assigned.  
* Supporting team members  
  * Encourage and uplift team members ideas  
* Raising concerns early  
  * Communicate concerns to WhatsApp group chat as soon as possible.  
* Follow all values and commitments listed in this team agreement.


Samuell Bueno

Kaid Silzer-Krueckl
